mapper.select: SELECT department_id FROM spectra_core.sys_user_department_membership WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted IS NULL ORDER BY department_id

SELECT department_id FROM ( SELECT department.id AS department_id FROM spectra_core.sys_user AS user_record JOIN spectra_core.sys_department AS department ON department.id = user_record.primary_department_id AND department.deleted IS NULL WHERE user_record.id = #{userId} AND user_record.deleted IS NULL
UNION
SELECT membership.department_id FROM spectra_core.sys_user_department_membership AS membership JOIN spectra_core.sys_user AS user_record ON user_record.id = membership.user_id AND user_record.deleted IS NULL JOIN spectra_core.sys_department AS department ON department.id = membership.department_id AND department.deleted IS NULL WHERE membership.user_id = #{userId} AND membership.deleted IS NULL ) AS department_memberships ORDER BY department_id

SELECT user_id, department_id,
FROM spectra_core.sys_user_department_membership WHERE deleted IS NULL AND user_id IN
#{userId}
ORDER BY user_id, department_id
mapper.update: UPDATE spectra_core.sys_user_department_membership SET deleted = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{operatorId}, version = version + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted IS NULL
